notes.title: Let's Play: Ookami Okami DEMO with Lely
notes.notes: [p]Watch Lely, our marketing, play the Ookami Okami demo![/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The demo will show the early parts of the story and offer a charming introduction to the main characters -Akine ([i]you[/i]) and Shimon ([i]Love Interest[/i])- filled with playful banter, flirty exchanges, and plenty of funny moments. We hope you try it out yourself and share your experience with us![/p]

notes.title: Ookami Okami Demo Available NOW!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Ookami Okami Demo is LIVE![/b] 🍁[/p][p]
The wait is over! Step into Akine’s world, enjoy the autumn vibes of the game, and get ready to meet the dashing, long-haired, bearded White Tiger God, Shimon. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614093/6a540d349b3f978f1df3a2b5d7b0607853ca0a56.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The demo will show the early parts of the story and offer a charming introduction to the main characters, filled with playful banter, flirty exchanges, and plenty of funny moments.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614093/9742c6927132bde663d4729f4d9b7d0e5e78e6d3.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614093/333d6d46357152435ccefb625fa7e52d91621ccd.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614093/cc15f5d26a98a6c6b37ba162766ad67bb73681af.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614093/5bfb1351cdccb8d1e1509f50e8d3ec0f6b10cacc.png"][/img][/p][p]For those who tried the prototype demo, this update includes updated art, bug fixes, and UI improvements for a smoother, more polished experience.[/p][p][/p][h3][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3703750/Ookami_Okami/" style="button" buttoncolor="#de2417"][b]Play the demo now![/b][/url][/h3]
